title: Level 999 Goblin
altTitles: ก็อบลินเลเวล 999
description: Kim Chulsoo works hard both in real life and in the game to make a living by doing manual labor and selling items. When he finally gets the opportunity to change to a hidden class, he hopes this will be his chance to turn his life around. However, the hidden class turns out to be a Goblin Summoner. His summoned goblin is a level 999 monster with overwhelming power, but it cannot be unsummoned, forcing Chulsoo to adapt to his new companion while pursuing success and wealth.
author: Dapi
